prompts: A client loves the woodblock print attached, also in {WS}/print.jpg; it is in the public domain. They want a 3D wallpaper that copies it: its composition, its palette and its subjects, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it at a glance, rebuilt as our own low poly scene with some gentle motion. Deliver {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code: the print is the reference, not a texture. Record in {WS}/result.json what you took from it: boats (how many the print shows) and mountain (its name). It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal]
Low-poly 3D wallpaper rebuilding Hokusai's print as code-only scene, plus result.json recording what was taken from it.

[action]
- Inspected ./print.jpg: it is *The Great Wave off Kanagawa* (Kanagawa-oki nami-ura, c. 1831). Read off: 3 boats (left under the great wave, mid-right below the mountain, largest in foreground, crews of nine), Mount Fuji snow-capped small center-right, prussian-blue two-tone sea, off-white claw foam, aged-paper beige sky.
- Wrote ./scene/index.html: single file, everything built in code (no textures). Only external refs: three@0.170.0 module from the exact allowed jsdelivr URL and Google Fonts (Shippori Mincho) for a vertical cartouche overlay. Great wave = flat-shaded tube curl with dense off-white claw foam and a dark fill behind the curl; secondary right wave; vertex-colored two-tone low-poly sea; 3 boats (tan hulls, raised ends, 9 dark-teal crew each) in the print's troughs; Fuji = gray cone + white cap cone in the gap between the waves; faint sun disc and cloud wisps. Gentle motion: sea swell, wave bob, pulsing foam, rocking boats, subtle camera drift.
- Wrote ./result.json: boats count 3, mountain Mount Fuji, plus composition and palette.
- Verified live in a browser: first render exposed 4 problems (curl hole showing sky, oversized sparse foam, Fuji hidden, mid boat occluded); two revision rounds fixed them; final screenshot shows Fuji as a small snow-capped peak in the gap with the boat below it, claw wave left, right wave, three boats, beige sky. Closed all browser tabs afterward.

[result]
Both deliverables in place and browser-verified: ./scene/index.html (opens directly, no build step) and ./result.json (boats: 3, mountain: Mount Fuji).

[how I know it is right]
Visual inspection of print.jpg identified the print and its elements; the browser screenshot of the running scene was checked against the print for composition (left claw wave, right swell, small Fuji center-right, three boats in the same troughs), palette (prussian blues, foam white, paper beige, tan boats), and both required facts in result.json.

[next]
None; if desired, the claw foam density or Fuji size can be tuned further, but the scene stands as a complete first deliverable.
